description: Electronics calculators with exact answers: LED resistor value, resistor color code, 555 timer frequency, voltage divider output, Ohm's law, series and parallel resistor totals, RC time constant, RC filter cutoff, transistor base resistor, capacitor code, PCB trace width and battery life. Returns the answer, the working, and a link that opens the matching circuit running live. Values may use SI prefixes ("4.7k", "100n", "15m"); inputs left out take example values, listed in the answer. Free and instant, with no daily limit.

inputs.description: The calculator's inputs by name, such as { "supplyV": "9", "ledV": "2", "currentA": "15m" } for led-resistor. Inputs by calculator: resistor-color-code (d1, d2, d3, exponent, tolerance); led-resistor (supplyV, ledV, currentA); voltage-divider (vin, r1, r2); rc-time-constant (ohms, farads, supplyV); ohms-law (volts, ohms); series-parallel-resistor (arrangement, r1, r2, r3, r4, supplyV); transistor-base-resistor (loadV, loadA, controlV, hfe, overdrive); 555-timer (r1, r2, farads, supplyV); pcb-trace-width (amps, riseC, oz, layer, lengthMm, supplyV); battery-life (capacityMah, activeMa, usablePct, volts, activePct, sleepMa); rc-filter (ohms, farads, hz); capacitor-code (code, tolerance). Band colors may be color names ("yellow"), d3 may be "none" on a 4-band resistor, and arrangement may be "series" or "parallel".
